title: The app crate may depend only on the shared crate

host-dependency.message: This Cargo manifest depends on a crate other than the workspace's `shared` crate.
host-dependency.help: Depend only on `shared`, or move this dependency (and whatever needs it) into `shared` itself.

metadata.source: Synthetic example demonstrating toml.v1: a Cargo workspace dependency-boundary rule, structurally parsing Cargo.toml instead of a line-by-line regex.
